other_conditions: After‑care eligibility requires continuous residence in a childcare institution for at least 5 years (or exemption for orphans).
For sponsorship, the child must be under 18 years, parents deceased, and living with a relative or guardian who is not eligible under the Mukhyamantri Covid‑19 Bal Seva Yojana.
Financial assistance for after‑care is provided only until the child reaches 24 years of age.
Sponsorship benefits cease after the child turns 18 years.
The child must be declared as a child in need of care and protection by the Child Welfare Committee to receive benefits.
benefits_summary: Provides monthly financial assistance, internships, vocational and technical education support to orphaned or care‑leaver children up to age 24.
